**Narratives in retrieved evidence**
Evidence is selected in index order, not a representative sample. Descriptions apply only to these retrieved posts; counts above cover the complete scope.

**` news `** - 10 of 207 matching posts retrieved.
Posts tagged #news are largely syndicated headline-style items spanning local crime and weather plus international affairs: an Old Town business burglary [T4-004335](#T4-004335), ashes washing ashore [T4-000005](#T4-000005), storm cleanup [T4-002737](#T4-002737), a Saudi reform plan [T4-002158](#T4-002158), a voluntary evacuation on Bolivar Peninsula [T4-000272](#T4-000272), Tropical Storm Hermine on Florida's Gulf coast [T4-003280](#T4-003280), Syrian forces entering Palmyra [T4-009314](#T4-009314), Thailand's crackdown on migrant workers [T4-003780](#T4-003780), a US assessment of a Houthi role in a strike on a warship [T4-004161](#T4-004161), and Merkel on resolving Syria without Assad [T4-009258](#T4-009258).

**` blacklivesmatter `** - 10 of 141 matching posts retrieved.
These posts mix protest coverage, race-related commentary and criticism of the movement: an interstate bridge blockade attributed to #BlackLivesMatter protesters in Memphis [T4-002764](#T4-002764), claims of rotten bananas thrown at Black students at American University [T4-009406](#T4-009406), Idris Elba on a UK "feeling of uprising" after US police brutality [T4-009392](#T4-009392), a police-brutality/#acab message urging fact-checking [T4-009247](#T4-009247), hostile framing of protesters as Soros/Hillary "professional rioters" [T4-009417](#T4-009417), anti-movement commentary about rap and "unity not division" [T4-009288](#T4-009288), plus cultural/celebrity and location-tagged items [T4-009246](#T4-009246) [T4-009384](#T4-009384) [T4-009379](#T4-009379) [T4-009393](#T4-009393).

**` world `** - 10 of 111 matching posts retrieved.
The #world group is dominated by international hard-news headlines: Syria (government forces in Palmyra [T4-009314](#T4-009314); Merkel on a post-Assad resolution [T4-009258](#T4-009258)), US-Yemen/Iran tensions (Houthi role in a warship strike [T4-004161](#T4-004161); denial that an Iran payment was a ransom [T4-002983](#T4-002983)), Europe (Munich mall shooting [T4-002862](#T4-002862); Spanish arrests over Islamist militant links [T4-004142](#T4-004142)), plus a Saudi reform plan [T4-002158](#T4-002158), Thailand's migrant-worker crackdown [T4-003780](#T4-003780), EU scrutiny of Gabon's election [T4-003349](#T4-003349), and Kerry-China talks on an Obama visit and North Korea [T4-003013](#T4-003013).

**` maga `** - 10 of 92 matching posts retrieved.
This group centers on pro-Trump political messaging and endorsements: praise of Trump's competence [T4-003807](#T4-003807), the Senate tax bill as "another great step" [T4-009099](#T4-009099), "historic" first-term accomplishments [T4-008945](#T4-008945), Trump's Poland rally crowd [T4-008455](#T4-008455), and Giuliani heading a cyber-security committee [T4-005909](#T4-005909). Other posts attack polling [T4-004144](#T4-004144), urge calls to a senator over an ad blamed on Soros and the "deep state" [T4-009068](#T4-009068), stack movement slogans like #DrainTheSwamp and #BuildTheWall [T4-007884](#T4-007884), promote a media appearance with many mentions [T4-009120](#T4-009120), or are slogan-only [T4-009031](#T4-009031).

**` tcot `** - 10 of 82 matching posts retrieved.
These posts are conservative-leaning commentary, often slogan-heavy with little text: attacks on arguments about police killings of Black people [T4-002806](#T4-002806), anti-communist and anti-Islam rhetoric [T4-007837](#T4-007837) [T4-002804](#T4-002804), Russian-hacking claims [T4-008134](#T4-008134), a call to remove a teacher over a student's test [T4-004047](#T4-004047), a march invitation combining #pjnet and #MAGA [T4-008600](#T4-008600), a slogan stack including #LNYHBT and #BuildTheWall [T4-007884](#T4-007884), and vague or purely promotional replies such as "Very cool" and "Absolutely!" [T4-008280](#T4-008280) [T4-006419](#T4-006419) [T4-002652](#T4-002652).
